title: Conditions
description: Write if/else chains, define an enum, and switch on it.

checkpoints.title: Battery status
checkpoints.description: batteryStatus(percent) maps a percentage to EMPTY/LOW/MEDIUM/FULL.

checkpoints.title: DriveMode enum
checkpoints.description: A DriveMode enum with TANK, ARCADE, SWERVE, and FIELD_ORIENTED_SWERVE values (team standard: UpperCamelCase type name, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE values).

checkpoints.title: Drive mode name
checkpoints.description: driveModeName(mode) uses a switch statement on the DriveMode enum to name a drive mode.

checkpoints.title: Can enable
checkpoints.description: canEnable(has_comms, e_stopped) combines conditions with && and !.

checkpoints.title: Is weekend
checkpoints.description: isWeekend(day) uses || to check for Saturday or Sunday.
